howItWorks.title: Simple Steps to Make a Difference
howItWorks.subtitle: Our streamlined process ensures your concerns reach the right authorities quickly

step1.title: Report Issues
step1.description: Spot a problem in your community? Take a photo, pinpoint the location, and describe the issue. Our smart system categorizes it automatically.

step2.title: Track Progress
step2.description: Monitor your report in real-time. See when it's assigned, under repair, and resolved. Get instant notifications every step of the way.

step3.title: Earn Rewards
step3.description: Contribute to your community and climb the leaderboard. Earn badges, points, and recognition for your civic participation.

step4.title: Community Power
step4.description: Vote on issues that matter most. When many citizens report the same problem, it gets prioritized for faster resolution.

step5.title: Analytics
step5.description: Track trends in your area. View resolution rates, common issues, and community impact statistics.

step6.title: Smart Alerts
step6.description: Stay informed with personalized notifications. Never miss updates about issues you care about.

about.title: About CivicPulse
about.description: Empowering communities through technology. Connecting citizens with their local government to create cleaner, safer, and better neighborhoods.

mission.label: Our Mission
mission.text1: CivicPulse is a revolutionary MEAN stack platform designed to bridge the gap between citizens and municipal services. We believe that every voice matters and every issue deserves attention. Our platform makes it easy for residents to report civic issues, track their resolution, and be rewarded for their active participation in community improvement.
mission.text2: By leveraging modern technology, we're transforming the way communities interact with local government, making civic engagement accessible, transparent, and rewarding for everyone.

feature0.title: Easy Reporting
feature0.description: Report civic issues instantly with photos and location data. Your voice matters in building a better community.

feature1.title: Community Driven
feature1.description: Connect with fellow citizens who care about their neighborhood. Together, we create positive change.

feature2.title: Fast Response
feature2.description: Issues are quickly assigned to municipal workers who can address them efficiently and effectively.

feature3.title: Rewards System
feature3.description: Earn points and recognition for active participation. Your engagement helps build a better city.

feature4.title: Transparency
feature4.description: Track the status of reported issues in real-time. See the impact of your contributions.

feature5.title: Moderation
feature5.description: Quality-controlled platform ensures legitimate issues get attention while spam is filtered out.

step0.title: Spot an Issue
step0.description: Notice a pothole, broken streetlight, or other civic problem in your neighborhood.

step1.title: Report It
step1.description: Take a photo, add location details, and submit your complaint through our easy-to-use platform.

step2.title: Get Verified
step2.description: Our moderation team reviews submissions to ensure quality and legitimacy.

step3.title: Track Progress
step3.description: Municipal workers are assigned to fix the issue. Follow updates until completion.

step4.title: Earn Rewards
step4.description: Gain points for verified reports and climb the leaderboard as a civic champion!

user0.description: Report issues, track progress, and earn rewards for making your community better.

user1.description: Engage in civic activities, compete on leaderboards, and build a portfolio of community service.

user2.description: Receive assigned tasks, manage workload efficiently, and resolve issues quickly.

user3.description: Oversee platform operations, moderate content, and ensure smooth civic engagement.

vision.label: Our Vision
vision.text1: We envision a future where every citizen is an active participant in shaping their community. Through CivicPulse, we're building a platform that not only solves problems but also fosters a sense of ownership and pride in our neighborhoods.
vision.text2: Our goal is to expand across cities, creating a network of engaged communities working together with local governments to build smarter, more responsive urban environments.
